meta.projection: Equal Earth (Šavrič et al. 2018), matching world-map.json

kernel.note: σ ≈ 550 km (floored to ≥16 map px) at mid-latitudes in Equal Earth map pixels; weight = unique citing works per institution

hex.note: Equal-area hexbin on Equal Earth (~300 km flat-to-flat). Weight = sum of unique citing works at institutions whose projected point falls in the cell.

meta.unit: Each institution contributes weight = count of unique non-self citing works listing that affiliation. Multi-affiliation papers add weight at each institution with coordinates. Same institution is not stacked per coauthor.
meta.sameScale: Lead density quantized against All max (glow grid + hex weights) so the Lead lens looks dimmer, not re-scaled.
meta.selfCitationRule: Same as Reach: drop citing work if it shares any author with the cited paper (OpenAlex ID / ORCID / normalized full name).

gaps.note: Works with no OpenAlex affiliation still count in the country choropleth. Institutions without geo.latitude/longitude contribute no glow/hex. Multi-campus systems (e.g. CAS) plot at the OpenAlex HQ city.
